{{Quote|Chog says the dress was computer generated, based on mistress Mara's measurements and other numbers&hellip;''"<br />"''Tell him we're looking for something more art than it is science&hellip;|[[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]] and [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa Solo]] comment on Chog's designs|<ref name="Union 1" />}}
'''Chog''' was an [[Alien/Legends|alien]] clothing designer on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] who used mathematics to tailor each piece of clothing to a client. He designed one of the many dresses for [[Mara Jade Skywalker|Mara Jade's]] [[Marriage/Legends|wedding]], but it was one of the many that were rejected by the bride-to-be.<ref name="Union 1" />
